name: DSHBox
notes: Adjacent: the app's main job is hosting DeepSeek Harness (DSH), a coding-agent runtime, on Android 10+ ARM64 without root or Termux, alongside a terminal and file manager; the GUI executors are bundled tools that DSH chooses between. The browser workspace exposes 24 tools through a bundled browser-use plugin and a sandbox browser CLI (observe, locate, click on screenshot coordinates, type, scroll, screenshot, plus opt-in CDP debugging). Pilot, the phone assistant, lists 39 capabilities and reaches the app layer through a file-based mailbox; its vendored interlock-relay core has an Accessibility backend (node actions and gestures on the default display), a Shizuku shell backend that can also act on a background virtual display, and direct platform calls, behind approval gates. The README declares GPL v3 for the project; pilot/NOTICE marks interlock-relay-core as Apache-2.0 and the DSHBox adapter as GPL-3.0, and PRoot, Debian and other components keep their own terms. README.md is in Chinese and README.en.md in English. Not a fork, not archived. Code was read, not run.
summary: Android app that runs the DeepSeek Harness agent locally in a PRoot Debian sandbox and gives it a WebView browser CLI and a phone assistant that operates native apps via Accessibility and Shizuku backends.
